verdict.rationale: Decagon documents several of its own features that run autonomously once configured. Watchtower applies user-defined natural-language criteria to every interaction, proactive agents initiate outbound calls at the right moments, and Duet and Suggestions automatically iterate on the agent and detect knowledge gaps. However, these are fixed, feature-specific background processes rather than a general facility for setting up arbitrary automations. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation/workflow builder, documented triggers or recurring schedules, details on how users configure and monitor background runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Watchtower reviews every interaction against your custom criteria and surfaces what matters most.
Define what matters using natural language.
Initiate intelligent, on-brand calls that reliably reach customers at the right moments throughout their journey.
Duet automatically iterates on your agent, from the first launch through every improvement after.
It automatically detects knowledge gaps and generates content drafts
